sn54.20:1.1: See SN 48.64 and notes. I believe this opening fragment is a separate discourse, and what follows is a distinct discourse combining the items of SN 54.17–20.
sn54.20:1.2: Unlike SN 48.64:2.1, the text does not coherently present a complete separate Sutta. Nonetheless, I believe this is due to faulty editing. This should start with, “Mendicants, when immersion due to mindfulness of breathing is developed and cultivated it leads to …”, but this is not found in any edition I have seen.
